Ravi: Starting canary for v4.0-int4-compact. Want to validate the rollout "ladder" + slice-smoothing rules before we open traffic.
Mei: Key points: (1) quick-detect mini-window 1m for spikes, (2) require confirm-window 20m for hard rollback, (3) per-slice min samples + EB smoothing for low-counts.
Talia: Suggest using FDR correction across slices so we don't over-react to multiple small p-values. Also add semantic-concordance for longdocs (cosine on 50-sample holdout).
Ravi (snippet): ```yaml
ladder:
  - t: 1% -> 3% -> 10%
  - quick_window: 1m
  - confirm_window: 20m
rules:
  quick_rollback:
    when: mrr_delta < -0.035 AND halluc_rate_delta > 0.02
    action: rollback
  soft_throttle:
    when: mrr_delta < -0.008
    action: cap_traffic: 10%
```
Mei: Also require global sample_count >= 1200 for quick_rollback. If sample < threshold, fall back to soft_throttle.
ops-bot: canary shadow run started: v4.0-int4-compact -> shadow 2h.
canary-bot: canary opened: 3% traffic at 2025-09-02T09:34:00Z
Aaron (SRE): I'll watch p95 & GPU lane contention. Set autoscale +1 during ladder steps. Tag me before jumping to 10%.
Talia: We'll publish per-slice FDR-adjusted p-values and a concordance digest in the canary report. If any slice contributes >6% weighted-MRR loss escalate to manual hold.
Ravi: Nice. Running shadow now, will post the short report and link the gate manifest when ready. :rocket:
